rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice before an adjective for “fairly,” “quite,” or “pretty,” sometimes with deliberate understatement.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6 wo3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an attractive person or a nice-looking thing.

example.jyutping: go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 zan1 hai6 leng3

rows.note: Use this especially for an object, design, show, or other thing that is pleasing to look at.

example.english: The design of this shirt is pretty.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 go3 fun2 hou2 tai2
